2.3.28 Report.RightMargin
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Report.RightMargin element specifies the width of the right margin of a Report. The
Report.RightMargin element is optional. If this element is present, its value MUST be an RdlSize. If
this element is not present, its value is interpreted as "0in".
Following is the parent element of the Report.RightMargin element.
Parent elements
Report
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Report.RightMargin element.
 <xsd:element name="RightMargin" type="SizeType" minOccurs="0" />
